question: Which of the following sports made its Olympic Games debut at the 2024 Paris Games (2024 Summer Olympics)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Breaking**__.

__
 
• **Breaking **sports made its **Olympic Games debut **at the **2024 Paris Games **(2024 Summer Olympics).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Breaking is a competitive form of breakdancing will be an Olympic sport in Paris 2024.
 
• Athletes, known as b-boys and b-girls will compete for the ultimate sporting prize a place on an Olympic podium.
 
• Breakdancing mainly consists of four kinds of movement:
 
 
• Toprock, Downrock., Power moves, Freezes
 
 
 
• **Four sports** proposed by the **Paris 2024 **Organising Committee have been confirmed:
 
 
• Skateboarding, Sport climbing, Surfing Breaking
 
 
 
• Which will make its** Olympic debut,** building on the success of the sport at the Youth Olympic Games Buenos Aires 2018.
